name: inputs/text-field
title: Text field
description: A labelled field with hint and error text.

files.content:
export { TextField } from './TextField';
export type { TextFieldProps } from './TextField';

keyboard.action: Move focus into and out of the field.
Type. The counter updates as you go.

notes: The error and the hint are linked with `aria-describedby`, error first, and the field sets `aria-invalid` while an error is shown.
The counter is described to screen readers as “12 of 40 characters used” and announced at 10 and 5 characters left and at the limit.
Required fields say “(required)” in words, not with an asterisk alone.
The error state uses a thicker red edge and an icon, not colour alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Nothing in the field moves. Focus and error edges change instantly.
